title: Manager: three loose ends next to task 068 (hook's money wording, merge-limit sentence, merge-limit's limits.json read)
item: Make the hook's paid-command refusal name the reason permission, make SKILL.md's merge-limit entry agree with the park list, and make checks.py merge-limit fail with one line on a bad limits.json
motivation: Found by task 68's reviews (tasks/reviews/068-1.md, 068-2.md); each lies in lines task 68's branch did not change (checks.py unmerged exit 1).
notes: The hook text is a change to the merge hook's file, which task 68's notes kept out of that task; the owner decides whether the refusal text may change. The merge-limit sentence matters only once task 68 merges.
draft_note: Proposed by the manager on 2026-11-19 in task 68's park, from the outside and earlier problems of its two reviews.

outside_problems.problem: The push hook's paid-command refusal (about line 974 on task/068) says the task parks with reason money, an old reason that task 68 replaces with permission.

The merge-limit entry (lines 206-207 on task/068) says 'At the limit the manager merges nothing more and ends the run', which disagrees with task 68's park list, where a refused merge parks as your-action.
check_merge_limit (about line 559 on task/068) reads limits.json without catching errors and accepts a task_merges_per_review of 0 or below.
